name: Hougetsu Aqua
source:
An ordinary female student and a mahou shoujo. She's said to be the cutest in her year, but contrary to that reputation, there are no flighty rumors about her, and she is actually the serious, proper type.

She works hard every day at her club activities, her studies, and her class rep duties. She is athletic, but studying is not her strong suit.

As Ruby's daughter, she carries the blood of a mahou shoujo.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/mahou/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
